_comment: Session-wide rules. The implementer's own read boundary is NOT here any more:
it is a PreToolUse hook in .claude/agents/implementer.md driven by
[protected].unreadable, so it binds that one subagent instead of every session
in this repo. What stays session-wide is narrower and deliberate: nobody
working in this repo — orchestrator or human — reads gold or fixtures, which
is the property the committed receipts under runs/ were authored under.
runs/ itself is readable again: Gate 2 shows receipts and the trial skill
writes a report it has to be able to read back.
